stemMd: An energetically unfavourable cellular reaction proceeds when coupled to ATP hydrolysis. Which statement best explains this?

options.label: A
options.textMd: ATP makes energy conservation cease to apply.

options.label: B
options.textMd: ATP supplies new atoms by nuclear fission.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The combined reactions can have a negative total free-energy change.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The enzyme must be consumed as fuel.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Every individual reaction becomes spontaneous in isolation.

explanationMd: Free-energy changes add for coupled reactions. A sufficiently favourable ATP-hydrolysis step can make the overall process favourable, even when the uncoupled reaction is not.

distractorRationale.d: Enzymes are catalysts, not the energy source.
distractorRationale.b: ATP hydrolysis is a chemical reaction.
distractorRationale.e: Only the combined process must be favourable.
